golden_arithmetic: signed 19-bit pre-shift + M18 normalized to [2**16, 2**17) (bit17 = 0) + per-channel post-shift
weight_format: signed INT8 symmetric per output channel, zero_point=0
accumulator_format: signed INT24 with folded bias (see BIAS_BITS)
requant_format: round-even pre_shift 0..2, unsigned normalized M18, round-even post_shift 0..47
context_packing: 1536-bit word in LANE order; lane0 at LSB; each lane has 12 signed INT8 weights (byte0 at LSB). Lane L serves point L//cout, channel L%cout; spare lanes are zero. cout >= 16 makes lane order identical to channel order.
context_storage_encoding: bit-complement of the true context; required by the XLR SRL8 read port (Q = ~data[~A])
context_reload_protocol: source contexts only; build_descriptor_package.py creates single_srl40_v2 runtime table/stream: N=slots*batches, 39*N+40 accepted 40-bit items, first min(N,2) weights then two parameter contexts then remaining weights; read anchors/progress are internal RTL state
parameter_packing: per-channel parameters in LANE order (same lane map as contexts); bias 24 bits, pre_shift 3 bits, M18 17 bits, post_shift 5 bits; spare lanes zero
sigmoid_lut_format: 128 entries = the |code| half (codes 0..127); the negative half is the bitwise complement of rom[|code|]. Fixed across styles: the logits use the fixed scale SIGMOID_LOGIT_SCALE = 6/127, and the table is baked into the RTL, so a style switch must not change it.
